punchline: Kirk Hammett joined Metallica, then went home and looked for a guitar teacher.
thirty_sec: The day Metallica fired Dave Mustaine, Kirk Hammett got the job. He was good, but he knew he was not as good as he wanted to be, so he started weekly lessons with Joe Satriani. Satriani was strict and many of Hammett's peers stormed out. Hammett kept turning up for two years. Ryan Holiday says that is what a student does with ego: hands it to someone else.
